params.prompt: One continuous locked-off tripod shot, exact reference framing and perspective throughout. The bathtub is a real rigid manufactured product: preserve every edge, silhouette, material, position and proportion perfectly. Architecture and camera are completely still. Constant natural exposure, no edits, no zoom, no camera drift, no morphing, no text. Motion is ongoing from frame one through the last second at the same relaxed pace, never slowing into a still. Photoreal premium design campaign, silent. This is the exact green NINFEA bath with its wide flat flared rim. Simultaneously animate the whole environment: large mature leaves and fern fronds gently sway in overlapping phases at both edges and above; a mature leafy vine resting on the left bath rim moves softly in the breeze without growing or changing shape; slow water ripples continuously move through the full foreground lily pond and inside the bath; lily pads bob almost imperceptibly; dappled leaf shadows shift naturally on the stone wall and floor. Keep all rigid bath contours and limestone edges fixed. Not seedlings, no sprouting, no creeping new plants; this is an established lush garden alive with a light breeze. Clear restrained motion over broad areas, never just one leaf.

A seamless continuous ambient loop. Fixed tripod, absolutely no movement of camera, bathtub, island or cliff. The turquoise GRECA bath is rigid stone, identical geometry all through. The sea is in steady motion at the beginning, middle and end: large soft ripple bands travel across the entire foreground, flow around the island and continuously break its reflection. The water rhythm completes a natural cycle in eight seconds; at the matched first and last composition the water is still moving, never paused. Small slow wavelets, no spray or splash. Steady golden exposure, no light pulsation. Strong visible natural water motion covering the sea, but perfect stillness of the manufactured bath and architecture. Photoreal silent luxury cinemagraph. No cuts, no fade, no zoom, no static hold.
